capital.evidence_quote: Tegucigalpa is the constitutional capital and seat of government of Honduras

currency.evidence_quote: The Honduran Lempira (HNL, L) is the legal tender currency of the Republic of Honduras

timezone.evidence_quote: Honduras operates on Central Standard Time UTC-6 with no daylight saving time adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential supply voltage across Honduras is 110V/120V 60 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Operating frequency of the national electrical grid is 60 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Standard wall sockets accommodate US Type A and Type B plugs with two flat parallel pins

police.evidence_quote: Dial 911 for emergency police response throughout Honduras

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 195 for Cruz Roja ambulance dispatch and emergency medical assistance

sources.title: Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Honduras

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 198 for emergency fire and rescue services

general.evidence_quote: 911 is the central emergency dispatch center operational 24/7

sources.title: Instituto Hondureño de Turismo - Policía Turística

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Policía Turística patrols Roatán, Utila, and Copán Ruinas coordinating via 911

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: San Pedro Sula ve Tegucigalpa'da yüksek suç oranları nedeniyle seyahat planları gözden geçirilmelidir; Roatán ve Copán turistik bölgeleri güvenlidir.
advisory_headline.en: Reconsider travel to mainland cities due to crime; Roatan, Bay Islands, and Copan Ruinas are safe with standard caution.
advisory_headline.de: Reisen auf das Festland sorgfältig abwägen; die Bay Islands (Roatán) und Copán sind touristisch gut abgesichert.
advisory_headline.ru: Рекомендуется пересмотреть поездки на материк; острова Роатан и руины Копан безопасны при обычных мерах.
advisory_headline.es: Reconsidere viajar a ciudades del interior por delincuencia; Roatán y Copán son destinos turísticos seguros.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Honduras reach approximately 32.0 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds measure 48.5 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Claro and Tigo are the principal carriers with 4G coverage. Arriving visitors must complete the digital customs declaration (prechequeo.inm.gob.hn). Roatán is internationally famed for Caribbean scuba diving.

sources.title: Instituto Nacional de Migración de Honduras (INM)

esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Pre-check electronic registration is mandatory for all travelers entering or leaving Honduras

religion.value: Roman Catholicism (approx. 46%) and Evangelical Protestantism (approx. 41%) with Garifuna heritage
religion.evidence_quote: Catholicism and Protestantism coexist alongside Afro-indigenous Garifuna spiritual rituals

festivals.value: Feria Isidra Carnival in La Ceiba, Holy Week (Semana Santa) in Comayagua, Guancasco reconciliation ceremonies
festivals.evidence_quote: The Grand International Carnival of Friendship in La Ceiba is the premier annual cultural celebration

legal_cultural_warnings.value: Avoid walking alone after dark in San Pedro Sula and Tegucigalpa; use radio taxis or Uber. Never drink untreated tap water. Under the CA-4 agreement, a 90-day visa permits travel between Honduras, Guatemala, El Salvador, and Nicaragua.
legal_cultural_warnings.evidence_quote: CA-4 border convention allows 90 days of combined travel across the four signatory republics

tipping.value: Tipping 10% is customary in restaurants. In beach dive resorts in Roatán and Utila, tipping dive masters and boat crew ($5-10 per day) is standard practice.
tipping.evidence_quote: A 10% tip is standard in hospitality and diving services
